classSqlGenerator

Generationpackages/sql-faker/src/Generation/SqlGenerator.php:26
final class SqlGenerator
Restricted visibility: declared "@visibility root". Code outside that scope must not name this declaration.

Generates SQL from a common grammar and a plan supplied by the caller.

Dialect spelling and parser semantic actions are supplied at construction; the derivation, retry budget and non-empty guarantee are shared by all grammars.
